Photograph of the white-border [[Dagobah (Revised)]] card, published by [[Decipher]]. The photograph was published at the eBay image host; its photographer is unidentified.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/aXwAAOSwR6tlxnZh/s-l1600.webp complete obtained card photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1200 × 1600-pixel obtained photograph is retained as the source. Rectangle (335, 330)–(950, 1150) was extracted, with right and bottom coordinates exclusive. It was proportionally downsampled with Pillow Lanczos resampling to 350 × 467 pixels and saved as RGB PNG without inherited metadata. No perspective correction, border painting, badge removal, replacement wording or reconstruction was applied. This is a photographic reproduction, not a facsimile. The photograph's acquisition date does not establish the card's first publication date.

== Preservation ==
Wayback copy of this exact original (SHA-256 verified by the central preservation owner): [https://web.archive.org/web/20261120210114/https://swccg.com/wiki/images/a/a0/Dagobah-Revised-L-dagobah-physical-photo.png Internet Archive].
